cities.name: Sydney, Australia
cities.description: A vibrant harbour city known for its Opera House, its iconic bridge and its golden urban beaches.

cities.name: Melbourne, Australia
cities.description: A cultural capital with laneway cafes, street art, world-class galleries and a lively sports scene.

cities.name: Tokyo, Japan
cities.description: A dazzling metropolis where neon-lit towers, quiet shrines and some of the world's best food sit side by side.

cities.name: Kyoto, Japan
cities.description: The former imperial capital, famous for its historic temples, tea houses and thousands of red torii gates.

cities.name: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
cities.description: Famous for its beaches, its mountain-top statue and a carnival that fills the whole city with music.

cities.name: Sao Paulo, Brazil
cities.description: A sprawling skyline city with outstanding restaurants, museums and a nightlife that never really stops.

temples.name: Angkor Wat, Cambodia
temples.description: A massive 12th-century temple complex and the largest religious monument in the world, best seen at sunrise.

temples.name: Taj Mahal, India
temples.description: A white marble mausoleum in Agra, built by Emperor Shah Jahan and admired for its perfect symmetry.

beaches.name: Bora Bora, French Polynesia
beaches.description: Turquoise lagoons, overwater bungalows and calm, clear water that is ideal for snorkelling.

beaches.name: Copacabana Beach, Brazil
beaches.description: Rio's famous crescent of sand with a wave-patterned promenade, beach volleyball and sunset views.
